status: MODELED; dimensions ASSUMED unless a datasheet is named

electronics inside their housings.note: every part envelope inside the outer solid of its housing (walls 2-3 mm: the housing is printed in halves around the boards)

grip.note: targets ASSUMED: length >= 110 (95th-pct hand breadth about 97 mm), finger pitch 21-26 mm, circumference 120-150 mm

trigger_and_thumb.note: trigger face 70 mm from the back strap (index first joint), button 40-70 mm from the web of the hand (ASSUMED targets)

cuff_height_range.note: elbow (cuff) height 0.90-1.10 m covered by tilt 35-50 deg and the 0-250 mm telescope (target ASSUMED)

battery.cells: 14 x Molicel INR-18650-P30B (18.6 x 65.2 mm max, datasheet)
battery.note: the cartridge slides out rearward under the cuff without touching anything

parts.HEAD_SKID: replaceable wear skid (PETG / TPU), clips over the shell rim
parts.HEAD_EAR_L: yoke ear on the lid (moulded with the lid), pivot hole 6 mm
parts.HEAD_EAR_R: yoke ear on the lid (moulded with the lid), pivot hole 6 mm
parts.HEAD_ENVELOPE: envelope of the built shells (collision proxy)
parts.YOKE_CHEEK_L: yoke cheek with friction washer and pivot knob
parts.YOKE_CHEEK_R: yoke cheek with friction washer and pivot knob
parts.TXD_HOUSING: TX driver housing beside L1 (+Y), heat-sink vents on its outer face (position from the rf2_system echo search)
parts.F1_A: F1 hinge half A with over-centre lever lock
parts.F2_A: F2 hinge half A with over-centre lever lock
parts.L2_TELE: inner telescoping tube 22 / 19.6 (collapsed; slides out 0-250 mm)
parts.REF3_SLEEVE: REF3 as a sleeve on L2: X / Y saddle coils + Z solenoid under a 1 mm cover (no box; rf2_ref3 'sleeve')
parts.UP_NECK: neck from F2 into the grip head
parts.UP_GRIP_HEAD: grip head: HB2 main board, button, screen hinge, dial, trigger pivot
parts.UP_GRIP: pistol grip: 3 finger wedges (middle, ring, little), palm swell, pinky shelf; overmoulded TPE
parts.UP_TRIGGER: fighter-pilot trigger blade (index finger), pivot in the grip-head floor, tail presses SW_TRG
parts.UP_BUTTON: thumb power button (KSC2 TE below) with a light-pipe ring (3 x SK9822)
parts.UP_SCREEN: flip-up screen (1.28 in memory LCD class) hinged at the grip head's rear top edge; push-push latch
parts.UP_DIAL: 3-position mode dial (thumb side): two cam lobes on two KSC2 TE
parts.UP_SPINE: spine beam: PWR board (LMR36520, regenerative buck), cable to the bay contacts
parts.UP_CUFF: elbow cuff: 210 deg trough, r 46 mm, strap slots; folds flat
parts.UP_CUFF_STEM: cuff stem rising from the spine (cuff pivot at its base)
parts.UP_BAY: battery bay under the spine, open at the rear; blade contacts at its front
parts.UP_CARTRIDGE: battery cartridge: 7S2P Molicel P30B + BQ76952 + MT60 charge port; slides out rearward

mass.note: torque of the whole about the hand (head forward positive): the battery behind the hand is the counterweight; the cuff takes the rest

folds_to_backpack.note: Z-fold at F1 and F2, head turned on the yoke; candidates screened on surface samples, the winner verified with exact OCC distances

cable_bend_at_folds.note: the bundle's 180 deg loop through a hinge has a radius about equal to the hinge offset

fold_study_retired.note: the owner withdrew shaft folding (telescoping instead); kept as a record, not a pass / fail check
